title: Scotland's Steve Clarke Resigns as National Football Coach
summary: Steve Clarke has stepped down as the coach of the Scotland national football team following their exit from the World Cup. The Scottish FA confirmed his departure, which occurred despite a new contract being in place. His resignation marks the end of his tenure leading the team.
summary_points: Steve Clarke has resigned as Scotland's national football coach.
His departure follows Scotland's elimination from the World Cup.
The Scottish FA confirmed the coach's decision.
Clarke's resignation comes despite having a new contract.
